action: Tap ongoing VPN notification body, Pause; then tap stopped alert Resume

evidence_limit: Service-command and builder tests alone do not operate the posted actions.

open_gap: Real shade pause/resume; suppressed/revoked permission behavior.

action: Tap FilterLists progress/completion alert; tap subscription status on Home for Discover
business_effect: Current worker builds Home clear-task intent, not a direct Discover intent; correlate outcome with same job
evidence_limit: No worker/shade-to-job replay identified; refines WF:DISC-055.
manual_visual_check: Observe ongoing and completion bodies, cancel/retry states and denied channel; inspect Home then Discover history.
open_gap: Actual route and job identity on cold/warm launches.

action: Restart device with VPN on-boot on/off, consent present/missing
business_effect: Start only when method, preference and grant permit; otherwise reminder or no action
evidence_limit: Direct receiver/dispatch hooks, not lifecycle of a physical boot.
manual_visual_check: Cold reboot each configuration, verify no unsolicited activity, observe retained rules after unlock.
open_gap: Physical reboot and battery restrictions.

action: Send authorized Start/Stop externally; exercise busy and invalid input or unauthorized sender
business_effect: Signature protection, action guard and operation ownership; no unauthorized state changes
evidence_limit: Permission/delivery and controlled operations; not successful real signed client+VPN traffic.
manual_visual_check: From authorized integration request start/stop; confirm status, busy toast and DNS; compare unauthorized rejection.
open_gap: Authorized external client end to end.

action: Upgrade installed app with independent update schedules
business_effect: Package replacement repairs correct unique workers and retains user settings
evidence_limit: Direct delivery test; not a signed package replacement.
manual_visual_check: Upgrade same signer with daily source, set and app checks; inspect scheduled/due behavior and absence of duplicates.
open_gap: OS replace delivery plus due work.

action: Long-press launcher icon > Preferences
business_effect: Open main Preferences for installed variant, not Home
evidence_limit: Host XML/applicationId contract only.
manual_visual_check: Use real launcher entry cold/warm, check labels/icon and Back.
open_gap: Launcher dispatch and task history.

action: Long-press launcher icon > DNS requests
business_effect: Open DNS Log for installed variant
evidence_limit: Host XML contract only.
manual_visual_check: Tap shortcut with VPN recording on/off; inspect returned task.
open_gap: Launcher dispatch and correct target.

action: Long-press launcher icon > Your Lists
business_effect: Open ListsActivity for installed variant
evidence_limit: Host XML contract only.
manual_visual_check: Tap cold/warm, compare correct rules and Back; try shortcut after upgrade.
open_gap: Launcher/OEM dispatch and stale shortcut behavior.

open_gap: Multiple-source retained truth on network loss.

code_anchor: SourceModel / SourceLoader / VpnNetworkMonitor / VpnService / README Requirements
action: Subscribe DNS-capable mixed list then test exact, suffix, allow and redirect
business_effect: Honor supported semantics; unsafe/non-DNS rules skipped, no universal browser filtering
evidence_limit: Parser/packet boundaries separate.
manual_visual_check: Compare child/sibling and unsupported cosmetic rule in real app; inspect summary disclosure.
open_gap: Source UI to parser to retained live DNS.

code_anchor: SourceModel / SourceLoader / VpnNetworkMonitor / VpnService / README Requirements
action: Apply large non-root list set and reopen Home/Lists
business_effect: Sync and counts remain usable within release test budget; old configuration survives interruption
evidence_limit: Parameterized component benchmarks; default runner is not a specified scale/time budget.
manual_visual_check: Record dataset size, device memory, elapsed time, responsiveness and final rule count.
open_gap: Representative low-memory device and production workload.

code_anchor: SourceModel / SourceLoader / VpnNetworkMonitor / VpnService / README Requirements
action: Switch underlying networks/DNS while running; stop while callbacks pending
business_effect: Follow actual selected non-VPN network; no stale recovery after intentional stop
evidence_limit: API-dependent callbacks; overlap requires two suitable networks; simulation not physical coexistence.
manual_visual_check: Test API 26/27 direct default, 28-30 request and 31+ best network; same-transport overlap with distinct resolvers; capture winner and DNS.
open_gap: API34 cannot cover legacy path; multi-network hardware and consent.

code_anchor: SourceModel / SourceLoader / VpnNetworkMonitor / VpnService / README Requirements
action: Change mixed IPv4/IPv6 or IPv6-only network; compare known DoH route and unknown encrypted resolver
business_effect: Use selected resolvers, maintain finite provider routes; no claim to catch arbitrary encrypted DNS
evidence_limit: Mapper and host route table, not device-wide prevention.
manual_visual_check: Verify IPv6-only resolution and limited DoH coverage on actual network; compare Private DNS warning.
open_gap: OEM DNS behavior and encrypted-app bypass.

code_anchor: SourceModel / SourceLoader / VpnNetworkMonitor / VpnService / README Requirements
action: Install candidate on compatible unrooted physical hardware; launch and upgrade
business_effect: Confirm package, signer, version and launch; unsupported API below 26 is outside baseline
evidence_limit: Minimum API 26, target 34; CI debug emulator is not physical or production-signed artifact.
manual_visual_check: Run signed physical smoke recording artifact hash, API, device evidence and actual retained VPN traffic.
open_gap: Physical smoke and OEM coverage; compile SDK 36 is not tested-device evidence.

code_anchor: SourceModel / SourceLoader / VpnNetworkMonitor / VpnService / README Requirements
action: Navigate at large text, RTL, landscape, touch and non-touch input
business_effect: Labels, focus, targets, dialogs and final rows usable without clipping/overlap
evidence_limit: Eight selected screens, one configured environment per invocation; capture is not human acceptance.
manual_visual_check: Review baseline, 1.3/1.6 and RTL matrix; add short landscape, keyboard/TalkBack, tablet/small width, dark/light and loaded/error dialogs.
open_gap: No implied TV/automotive/Wear qualification; touch and telephony optional, no dedicated leanback launcher; per-OEM surfaces separate.

action: Paste URL/domain; press Check or IME Search/Done
business_effect: Normalize to intended hostname, reject invalid/credential input, newest query wins
evidence_limit: Normalized lookup/result; does not establish IME parity.
manual_visual_check: Compare button and keyboard; try invalid input, Unicode and rapid changes, inspect displayed host.
open_gap: IME focus, invalid and mixed-direction text.

action: Inspect blocked, redirected, allowed or unmatched result and source provenance
business_effect: Use active exact/suffix VPN truth; do not misstate read-only allow or redirect precedence
evidence_limit: Seeded data; display does not send traffic.
manual_visual_check: Compare result with actual matching parent/sibling/redirect packet and inspect long source labels.
open_gap: Live DNS/provenance comparison.

action: Tap Block, Unblock/allow, Remove allow or Delete user entry beside its source
business_effect: Change only permitted USER rule; source-owned provenance remains read-only; show success after sync
evidence_limit: Fixture tests of normalized mutation/timing.
manual_visual_check: Exercise each visible action; compare siblings, source rows and next query; rotate mid-write.
open_gap: Live tunnel enforcement after each action.

action: Retry failed write/read or act during import
business_effect: Preserve previous rule on failure, clear busy state, retry without duplicates or stale result
evidence_limit: Injected contention/error; not device storage incident.
manual_visual_check: Confirm feedback remains readable after background/return; ensure duplicate taps have no effect.
open_gap: Real storage/full conditions and accessible busy announcements.

action: Tap Record/Pause; generate DNS and pull to refresh
business_effect: Only new requests during recording appear; pause does not delete history; refresh stops spinner
evidence_limit: Generated VPN log and packet processor displayed; not full start/pause/swipe sequence.
manual_visual_check: Record known requests, pause, generate a different host, refresh twice.
open_gap: Real toggle and swipe while VPN stops/restarts.

action: Tap Sort twice
business_effect: Reorder same hosts by top-level domain versus alphabetic; no loss of entries
evidence_limit: Host source contract and comparator; no Android menu interaction.
manual_visual_check: Use hosts where two orders differ, verify actual order and persistence on return.
open_gap: Real menu and rendered grouping.

action: Tap Clear then refresh
business_effect: Clear request history; do not change rules or recording preference
evidence_limit: No exact menu replay mapped.
manual_visual_check: Clear populated history while paused, then record one fresh query.
open_gap: Destructive control/empty transition.

action: Tap hostname; long-press hostname
business_effect: Open correct host in browser or copy exact host to clipboard, no rule mutation
evidence_limit: No exact handoff/clipboard assertion mapped.
manual_visual_check: Return from browser, paste clipboard in plain text; try missing browser.
open_gap: External handler, current recycled row and clipboard feedback.

action: Tap block/allow icons or selected icon to remove; Apply
business_effect: Add/replace/remove intended exact user rule only, preserve unrelated suffix rules
evidence_limit: Adapter callback labels and VM writes are separate; not a joined Apply.
manual_visual_check: Act on a scrolled/recycled row, Apply, test host and sibling in live VPN.
open_gap: End-to-end callback through Apply and DNS.

action: Tap Redirect, enter IP, Add or Cancel; tap selected icon to remove
business_effect: Valid redirect stores exact IP; invalid/cancel leaves rules intact
evidence_limit: Actual row and dialog for valid input.
manual_visual_check: Try invalid, IPv6, cancel/outside and removal; confirm DNS answer and copy.
open_gap: Dismissal and real tunnel verification.

action: Open/reopen scanner and read scanning, empty or detected rows
business_effect: Detect visible installed packages matching static signatures; never imply all apps or new threats scanned
evidence_limit: Installed fixture/empty state; freshness copy is host source contract.
manual_visual_check: Read disclosure and long package names; compare with known visible fixture on restricted device.
open_gap: OEM/work-profile visibility and scan disclosure readability.

action: Tap detected app, cancel or complete Android uninstall and return
business_effect: Correct package in system confirmation; cancel retains row; real removal disappears on rescan
evidence_limit: Intercepted cancel and refreshed data; not completed OS removal in these methods.
manual_visual_check: Using disposable fixture verify system dialog name and package before/after uninstall.
open_gap: Historical screenshots not current candidate proof.

action: Open About from Preferences or More; read version, credits, license; Up
business_effect: Show installed version and actual license boundary, then return to caller
evidence_limit: Checks attribution/version; not an external licenses browser.
manual_visual_check: Compare installed version, read bottom text in large RTL, Up from both entries.
open_gap: Short-screen accessibility/return.

action: Choose each theme mode; cancel/recreate
business_effect: Selected mode persists, effective theme and system-follow behavior match choice
evidence_limit: Modes and persistence; not color/contrast review.
manual_visual_check: Inspect system/light/dark choices and system theme change on each open dialog.
open_gap: Contrast, system-follow repaint, cancellation.

action: Tap active VPN vs inactive Root row
business_effect: Open VPN configuration or relaunch chooser without silently changing stored mode
evidence_limit: getAdBlockModel dispatch alone would not test either row.
manual_visual_check: Read active/switch summaries; cancel chooser and check stored method and VPN status.
open_gap: Back/task behavior after switch attempt.

action: Toggle Force English; return to system language
business_effect: App locale changes, preference persists and mirrored layout updates
evidence_limit: Preference/locale test; not multilingual visual verification.
manual_visual_check: Switch from RTL locale to English and back, relaunch, inspect title, rows and dialogs.
open_gap: Mixed-direction text and non-default platform versions.

action: Inspect/toggle telemetry according to distribution
business_effect: Unsupported build forces off and disables control; supported build honors consent
evidence_limit: Build-dependent branch; neither a two-build comparison nor proof of backend traffic.
manual_visual_check: Inspect actual distribution; reboot and verify consent effect without collecting personal data.
open_gap: Supported-build branch conditional; stub cannot attest upload.

action: Toggle debug preference; reopen
business_effect: Persist diagnostics preference; distinguish debug behavior from telemetry
evidence_limit: No matching preference-to-log test identified.
manual_visual_check: Toggle twice, compare expected diagnostic verbosity on suitable build and restore.
open_gap: Debug switch persistence/consumer behavior.

action: Toggle IPv6 with live VPN and while stopped
business_effect: Reconfigure running tunnel with new preference; never start stopped VPN
evidence_limit: Actual switch/tunnel identity under consent; not every resolver network.
manual_visual_check: Change on IPv6-only and mixed networks; query known domain each way.
open_gap: OEM IPv6-only routing and return.

action: Tap Preferences > DNS log
business_effect: Open live log; Back returns to Preferences
evidence_limit: More row test is a different listener.
manual_visual_check: Use this preference on configured VPN; Back then Up.
open_gap: Specific entry/return unverified.

action: Tap Help or Donate in Preferences
business_effect: Hand off wiki or PayPal URL respectively; do not attribute Update buttons to these rows
evidence_limit: Separate preference listeners. CI source used unguarded starts; working branch uses SupportLinks with refusal feedback.
manual_visual_check: Inspect exact URI without transacting; refuse or remove browser, then return.
open_gap: Candidate-specific refusal and return via each preference.

action: Toggle app check at startup; cold launch, rotate and resume
business_effect: Check on fresh launch only when enabled
evidence_limit: Counting model; not a signed network update.
manual_visual_check: Compare fresh vs rotate/resume with test server or observable check.
open_gap: Real network check on candidate.

action: Toggle daily app check and Include beta
business_effect: Create/cancel unique periodic APK work; beta selectable only for eligible store and changes release selection
evidence_limit: Scheduling and distribution-dependent preference, not elapsed daily run.
manual_visual_check: Check enabled vs ineligible build, stable-only vs beta result; wait/drive scheduled check.
open_gap: Actual due job and channel-specific manifests.

action: Toggle hosts check on startup
business_effect: Label promises the next eligible launch checks source freshness according to this switch
evidence_limit: Likely inert: PreferenceHelper.getUpdateCheck has no production caller or other literal-key consumer found. Home reads getUpdateCheckAppStartup for APKs.
manual_visual_check: Cold launch with known newer feed with each setting; compare actual requests, freshness and UI without tapping update.
open_gap: Source-confirmed missing consumer; end-user effect not reproduced here.

action: Toggle daily hosts check and unmetered-only
business_effect: Schedule unique work with selected constraint; dependent controls unavailable when daily is off
evidence_limit: Work registration/constraints, not a metered handoff.
manual_visual_check: Change from Wi-Fi to metered; observe queued versus actual retrieval, then disable.
open_gap: Actual work dispatch and dependent rows.

action: Toggle auto update versus notify for daily hosts updates
business_effect: When changes are found, choose sync versus alert; disabling daily gates dependent switch
evidence_limit: No matching control-to-worker outcome method identified.
manual_visual_check: Use known updated list; observe notification or applied generation distinctly.
open_gap: Auto sync vs notify on due work.

action: Tap disabled-notifications row on API 33+, grant or deny in OS, return
business_effect: Show when runtime permission denied; open correct app settings without changing permission itself
evidence_limit: Tests current permission and row visibility; not OS Settings round trip.
manual_visual_check: Try denied, granted, and channel-only blocked separately; ensure row refreshed on resume.
open_gap: Physical settings tap and pre-33 absence.

action: Toggle Start VPN on boot
business_effect: Only enabled VPN method with grant can restore; no surprise start when disabled
evidence_limit: Boot dispatch with controlled dependencies; not a switch plus reboot test.
manual_visual_check: Toggle then power-cycle with grant revoked/granted; compare status before unlocking and after.
open_gap: OEM autostart restrictions, locked boot.

action: Toggle watchdog monitor
business_effect: Running service replaces worker as configured; intentional stop is respected
evidence_limit: Live worker changes, not a long suspended-device recovery.
manual_visual_check: Enable/disable across idle/network loss and intentional stop.
open_gap: Physical power management.

action: Toggle allow-app-bypass
business_effect: Persist choice, rebuild running tunnel, disclose bypass exposure
evidence_limit: Tunnel replacement/persistence; no independent client route verification.
manual_visual_check: Use a consenting test app bound outside VPN and a normal client; compare DNS and leak card.
open_gap: Observed per-app bypass versus inclusion.

action: Choose none, all or all except browsers in system-app exclusions
business_effect: Stored policy matches chosen system packages; own app not excluded by system rule
evidence_limit: Prefs and builder package sets, not actual per-UID traffic.
manual_visual_check: Test browser and nonbrowser system app under each mode, cancel picker and check summary.
open_gap: OEM browsers/packages and live route.

action: Open excluded-app picker; toggle row versus switch; Up/Back
business_effect: List visible non-system apps, persist intended package and rebuild only a running VPN on return
evidence_limit: Direct activity and one fixture row; not preference entry, switch hit target, or tunnel proof.
manual_visual_check: Use two apps; scroll/recycle, reopen, verify traffic for excluded and included client.
open_gap: Identity/visibility, empty list, persisted exclusion through live return.

action: Overflow Select all
business_effect: Exclude every currently displayed user package and rebind switches
evidence_limit: One row test does not select all.
manual_visual_check: Seed two visible apps plus system/self and previously invisible entry; inspect persisted set, reopened switches, actual routing.
open_gap: Bulk action, invisible packages and live routing.

action: Overflow Deselect all
business_effect: Reinclude displayed packages, clear exclusion state and update switches
evidence_limit: No exact bulk-clear test mapped.
manual_visual_check: Start with multiple excluded apps; Deselect all, Back/reopen, verify each client routes through VPN.
open_gap: Bulk clear, restart and independent client verification.

action: Tap Backup, choose JSON destination or cancel
business_effect: Create document with expected MIME/name; write complete recoverable rules and sources, preserve destination on rejected export
evidence_limit: Intent, controlled provider round-trip and capacity are separate.
manual_visual_check: Choose real provider, inspect exported JSON, cancel/deny and confirm no partial overwrite.
open_gap: Real SAF selection and grant lifetime, available storage.

action: Tap Restore, pick valid/repeated/malformed file or cancel during busy update
business_effect: Validate atomically, keep old data on failure; update VPN decisions without unexpected start
evidence_limit: Picker launch, import and warmed model are separate boundaries.
manual_visual_check: Test old provider MIME behavior on API 26/28/29+, cancellation, active tunnel and second import.
open_gap: Real SAF-to-traffic round trip.

action: Use Android backup transport to restore on replacement install
business_effect: Restore permitted prefs/rules and preserve valid state, distinct from JSON file picker
evidence_limit: Opt-in seed/assert phases; standalone methods or skips cannot establish transport.
manual_visual_check: Perform authorized platform backup, replace install and restore on compatible transport; compare settings and rules.
open_gap: Transport transaction and bound before/after pair.

action: Read available/current version and changelog; check/retry after failure
business_effect: Signed current result shows up-to-date; stale result cleared; never offer an unavailable download
evidence_limit: Controlled signed/network model and UI variants.
manual_visual_check: Check cold, offline, expired, current, available; rotate, inspect text/links at large font.
open_gap: Candidate store/network and all visual combinations.

action: Download on eligible build; leave and return, observe byte progress/verification/failure
business_effect: Track original download, fail closed on changed bytes, never equate provider success with installed
evidence_limit: Provider rejection and polling fixtures; no successful release install.
manual_visual_check: Observe known/unknown size, paused/removed download and recreated screen; compare installed version afterward.
open_gap: Signed direct-release install on compatible signer.

action: Open unknown-sources settings; deny/grant, cancel installer, retry or refetch expired metadata
business_effect: Reverify pending APK once, no auto-relaunch after cancel/expiry; only eligible build can install
evidence_limit: Controlled continuation and UI; Android installer launch is not completion.
manual_visual_check: Compare normal vs directRelease; cancel, repeat, then install known signed upgrade; check package/version/data.
open_gap: Signed distribution + settings + installer + retained configuration on device.
